notes: §1985:VI.7.3 presentation (kb/Work PB5212, landed): at --std 85 a debugging line that begins before the end of the OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph (or, with none, before the Data Division) is COBOL7060, and a program that is not syntactically correct with its debugging lines taken as comment lines is COBOL7061 at the last kept line before the first syntax error. Both are refused below 2002 only. Witnesses: pb5212-debugging-line-before-object-computer and pb5212-debugging-line-syntax-both-ways (refuse-at 85, accepted where the presentation rule does not apply). PB5990 (landed): the other direction of VI.7.3 'with or without': in a unit WITHOUT the mode the debugging lines are read as source too, through the same token screens and parse source text gets (lexer errors, COBOL5563, COBOL2633, the separator rules, the parse), and a failure is COBOL7675 at the last hidden line before the first error; a line COBOL7060 already refuses is not asked again. Witnesses: the four pb5990 refuse-at/accept goldens and pb5990-misplaced-debugging-line-reported-once.

next.reason: 1985: "If the WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause is specified in a program, all debugging lines are compiled"; 2023: "FMT-12.3.5.2: SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name-1 ] . (the format has no WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause)". The 2023 SOURCE-COMPUTER format keeps only computer-name-1, so the WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause is gone. No candidate makes compiling debugging lines depend on such a clause.
